mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals improving supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with INDPRO above its 6mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with lower rates indicating higher expected returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20d returns remains below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint labor signal remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal: during monetary easing cycles, a quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% YoY predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of easing quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 2%.
